scope: Workload taxonomy and candidate hardware/software execution paths. A path may only document a software integration or vendor report; it is not a certification of workload support. Only explicit workload tests or benchmark records can establish workload-specific validation.

status_definitions.integration_only: A software-to-platform integration is documented, but no workload-specific model/configuration validation is attached.
status_definitions.vendor_reported: A vendor publicly reports a workload or model adaptation; independent reproduction and benchmark comparability are not established.
status_definitions.workload_tested: A specific workload configuration has passed a documented correctness or functional test; performance is not implied.
status_definitions.benchmark_reported: A workload benchmark result is published with configuration and measurement metadata, but is not independently reproduced here.
status_definitions.independently_benchmarked: A benchmark result has been independently reproduced under a documented methodology.

workloads.name: LLM inference & serving
workloads.description: End-to-end online generation under a request-serving policy. Keep prefill and decode behavior visible rather than reducing the workload to a single tokens-per-second number.
representative_models: Dense and mixture-of-experts models (pin the exact architecture and revision in each test)
key_dimensions: TP / PP / EP topology and interconnect

workloads.name: LLM prefill
workloads.description: Prompt ingestion and context processing. Compare compute throughput, memory traffic and time-to-first-token under explicitly stated prompt lengths.

workloads.name: LLM decode
workloads.description: Autoregressive token generation, where KV-cache movement, memory bandwidth, batching and communication often dominate.
representative_models: Dense and MoE autoregressive LLM decode
metrics_to_report: Output tokens/s per device and per system

workloads.name: LLM pretraining
workloads.description: Large-scale distributed training from initialization. A valid comparison must preserve model shape, token budget, parallelism and convergence target.
key_dimensions: DP / TP / PP / CP / EP topology
metrics_to_report: Energy and cost per training token

workloads.name: LLM fine-tuning
workloads.description: Full-parameter and parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Separate software-framework availability from validated recipes, convergence and end-to-end throughput.

workloads.name: LLM model porting & adaptation
workloads.description: Port a model architecture and its operators to a new hardware/software stack. A model loading demo is not equivalent to a validated serving or benchmark result.
representative_models: New model architecture or model revision

workloads.name: Multimodal / VLM serving
workloads.description: Online inference for models combining text with image, audio or video inputs. Preserve modality-specific preprocessing and sequence expansion.
key_dimensions: Video frame count and sampling policy
metrics_to_report: Quality under a fixed evaluation set

workloads.name: Embedding & reranking
workloads.description: Vector embedding and relevance reranking for retrieval-augmented generation and search. Compare throughput only at a fixed model, sequence length and quality target.
metrics_to_report: Throughput at a fixed quality target

workloads.name: Diffusion image & video generation
workloads.description: Image and video generation pipelines. Separate text encoder, denoising, VAE and video temporal components when reporting latency.
metrics_to_report: Quality score under a fixed evaluator

workloads.name: Edge vision & perception
workloads.description: On-device and embedded vision workloads under power, thermal, memory and real-time constraints.
